items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: And then returning and then Wake Will and Sam Heiserbois.

ctx.x: You were talking about the breakfast lines, the boats, and when you played here. Did the boats, the same boat that stayed here in the wintertime, did it go upstream then in the summer?
Yes, the steamer capital, it worked here all winter. Then in the summer it would go up to St. Paul. And then returning and then Wake Will and Sam Heiserbois.
Do you remember who played the calliope on those boats?
